snippet.title: BloodJack - Official Cinematic Trailer | PvP Blackjack Card Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4726300/BloodJack/

BloodJack turns blackjack into a savage 2-4 player online table game. Hit, stand, bluff with a hidden card, and use rule-breaking items to mess with every hand, then suck your friends' blood before they suck yours.

Inspired by the table tension of Buckshot Roulette and the bluffing of Liar’s Bar.
